Class SimulationDefaults

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.SimulationDefaults
public final class SimulationDefaults extends Object
Central repository for simulation engine default values that were previously scattered as magic numbers across multiple classes. Reference each constant from the class that originally owned the literal so that future tuning only requires a change in one place.
